name: Sanchotello (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, red above and below and white at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sanchotello (crosses and a black bend on yellow).
history: The municipal flag is square, of proportion 1:1, quartered per saltire of white and red, charged at its centre with the municipal arms in its colours, timbred with the Spanish royal crown.

features.role: division per saltire, red above and below
Sanchotello arms — crosses and black bend on yellow
yellow field and crown of the arms
